status: Approved design integrated into the game and existing shop; release preparation only, not verified deployed.
name: Halloween March
art: Three human medieval soldiers, muted plum cloaks, steel armor, two spearmen and a pumpkin lantern bearer.

animation.technique: Two cached transparent atlases; measured frame clips aligned to one baseline. CSS transform steps select walking poses; one compositor animation moves along the current route segment. Heading comes from the screen-space segment vector. No per-frame JavaScript animation loop.
animation.static: Direction gallery and size comparison thumbnails

integrationRequirements: Keep authoritative route position, timing and mission indicators.
Preserve relationship colors and existing troop-count visibility rules.
Combined rallies use the leader's equipped appearance.
Apply and replicate through existing public cosmetic state.
limits: The standalone preview uses illustrative routes and sample counts/times.
Browser CPU throttling is a stress check, not a guarantee for every physical phone.
Overloaded full-map fixtures may lag with both default and Halloween markers; report those baselines alongside isolated decoration measurements.
No price, combat, movement, production-data or release-channel changes. The flag border is a separate draft.

production.technique: One shared 640x1280 WebP; cached troop nodes and direction rows. Four walking poses use CSS transform steps. Route position and timing use the existing authoritative march renderer.
